# ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/xmhpUQf.jpg) **Español**
Si eres socio de la **Asociación Española de Speedcubing (AES)** a día 8 de septiembre de 2024 y participas en la competición se te reembolsarán 3€ de la cuota de registro al finalizar ésta. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES pinchando [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).

# ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/whUqn2n.jpg) **English**
If you are **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)** member on September 8, 2024 and you participate in the competition, you will be reimbursed €3 of the registration fee at the end of the competition. You can join AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
